events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드's 4–1 home win over 선덜랜드 extends their winning run in the league to nine games.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pay 노팅엄 포리스트 £5 million for winger 저메인 지너스 .
Division One leaders 맨체스터 시티 pay a club record £5 million for 프레스턴 노스 엔드 striker Jon Macken .
Dick Advocaat is reinstated as the manager of the Netherlands , as the successor of the failing Louis van Gaal , with a 1–1 draw in a friendly against England in Amsterdam.
블랙번 로버스 beat 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at the Millennium Stadium to win the League Cup for the first time in their history.

Sir 알렉스 퍼거슨 changes his mind about retiring as 맨체스터 유나이티드 manager at the end of the season and signs a new contract which will keep him at the club for at least another three seasons. His team are still top of the Premier League, followed by 아스널, 리버풀, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 첼시. 레스터 시티 are sinking deeper into relegation trouble at the other end of the table, while an upturn in fortunes for 더비 카운티 is suggesting that John Gregory is their saviour. 블랙번 로버스, meanwhile, have little time to saviour their recent League Cup glory; they are still in the relegation zone. The race to get into the Premier League is similarly tense, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 맨체스터 시티 leading the way but facing strong pressure from an improving 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 side. The top six is completed by 밀월, 번리 and 코번트리 시티, while 버밍엄 시티 are moving closer to the playoff zone after a slow start to the season.
